newsitem.title: ITALY: Man loses condom appeal to Italy's highest court.
newsitem.headline: Man loses condom appeal to Italy's highest court.

text.p: A man convicted of assaulting a prostitute lost an appeal to Italy's highest court on Friday after arguing unsuccessfully that her refusal to have unprotected sex amounted to provocation.
The man, who was not named, took his case to the Court of Cassation after judges in Florence sentenced him to six months in prison for assault and battery.
He attacked the woman to try to get his money back after she refused to have sex without him wearing a condom.
The Court of Cassation rejected the man's appeal for mitigating circumstances of provocation and loss of temper to be taken into account.
Its written ruling said that protected sex was of "unquestionable necessity" for the prostitute and found that the man had no right to ask for his money back.
